spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
## Expressions: Anonymous function expression; Call; Variable reference

### Named and default arguments: For a variable declared with `var`, the signature is retained only when its initializer exposes a known atomic function signature. Supported initializers include anonymous function expressions
reason: All four negative cases assert rejection of calls with missing required positional arguments or excess positional arguments to explicitly typed or inferred anonymous functions. Anonymous functions, captured local references, local declarations and calls are supported; these arity errors are within the supported grammar and type system, and no invocation restriction excludes these atomic signatures.
test_design_notes: The @error markers require compile-time rejection: test1/test2 omit a required argument; test3/test4 supply excess arguments.
